endorsements.name: Valentin Hamon
endorsements.label: Malicious URI Resolving in PDFs
endorsements.description: Attacks by PDFs are most often done from inside PDFs themselves, they are so subject to shape detection. Now, imagine that the malicious content is not in the PDF opened by the victim. In fact, using internal legitimate Adobe mechanisms to do so can be advantageous for an attacker. Submitting forms allows these possibilities. It is not like the well known method URI, it is better. It allows an attacker to greatly expand his panel of attacks from a PDF.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Middle-East 2012
